criticalFindings.finding: Pinned GeckoViewPermission.sys.mjs stores ordinary content allow/deny/prompt with Services.perms.EXPIRE_NEVER; storage-access takes separate path
criticalFindings.consequence: Native5minute/3hour/15day grant expiry alone cannot revoke cached engine allow. Do not claim finite expiry works or mark PermissionCoordinator ready.

criticalFindings.finding: StorageController.setPermission is void dispatch, readback is separate
criticalFindings.consequence: submitted revocation remains pending; timer/UI invalidation is not engine acknowledgement. Background/process-death cases need bounded reconciliation before opening affected business sessions.

criticalFindings.finding: Geolocation module asks Android ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION after content approval; Native API has one geolocation type
criticalFindings.consequence: Existing approximate/precise distinction and coarse-only OS state need actual synthetic/native validation; never claim FINE granted merely because COARSE exists or show precision not observed.

criticalFindings.finding: persistent-storage grant cannot be revoked per SDK documentation; tracking VALUE_PROMPT update is ignored
criticalFindings.consequence: Do not expose fictitious reversible switches or use a universal reset-to-PROMPT function for every permission type.

criticalFindings.finding: ContentPermission.notifyShown exists and requires a live prompt; restored JSON permissions have no live request id
criticalFindings.consequence: Notify once only after Native UI actually shown, never on queue/admission or as permission consent.

criticalFindings.finding: Pinned storage-module SetPermission writes EXPIRE_NEVER for normal state, EXPIRE_SESSION for private state, no completion callback; host executing exact source with mocks observed this
criticalFindings.consequence: private-session lifetime is not arbitrary finite grant lifetime; keeping normal cached allows while only dropping app grant metadata remains unsafe. Host Services are synthetic, not real permission manager validation.

criticalFindings.finding: GeckoAppShell source first chooses most accurate/recent last-known Location across ALL providers and publishes it before applying COARSE/FINE provider-selection Criteria. AndroidListeners forwards raw coordinates; per-request native downstream not inspected.
criticalFindings.consequence: enableHighAccuracy=false or Criteria.COARSE is not per-site coordinate redaction/privacy enforcement, especially when app already holds FINE for another scope. Source-method harness16checks confirms synthetic branch only; no actual location precision/OS result observed.

criticalFindings.finding: Java updateLocationListeners paused=true/requested=true branch returns without removeUpdates; global AndroidListeners callback has no inspected pause filter. No per-site identity in this Java provider path.
criticalFindings.consequence: Do not use global pauseLocation as one-site expiry or claim it acknowledges existing capture stopped. Native downstream/lifecycle may behave differently and remains unverified.

Separately establish whether expiry only rejects new requests or also stops existing watches/tracks; do not promise active capture stopped on a permission-map change
No new privileged permission helper/API introduced until bounded scope and actual engine semantics justify it; subapp occupancy/cleanup remains deferred

exact contextA/contextB permission isolation and stale callbacks after navigation
